customer_question: We have a derivative product (expansion model) that uses the same module and Host Stack as our already-certified product. Do we need to pay another Qualification Fee to add it?
question_variants: Can we add expansion models to an existing SIG certification for free?
How do we use 'Manage Submitted Products' to add a derived product?
actual_issue: Products that use an identical module QDID and Host Stack as an already-certified product can be added to the existing Product List for free via the 'Manage Submitted Products' function in SIG Launchstudio. No additional Qualification Fee is charged. This is the standard mechanism for listing derivative or expansion models under an existing certification.
plain_english_explanation: If a new product model uses the exact same Bluetooth module and Host Stack as a product that is already certified and listed in SIG's system, there is no need to pay another SIG Qualification Fee. Instead, the customer (or consultant on their behalf) uses the 'Manage Submitted Products' function in SIG Launchstudio to add the new product model to the existing Product List. This is free of charge and typically approved quickly. This is specifically for derivative or expansion models — if the module or Host Stack changes, a new Design registration is required.
consultant_answer: Derivative products using the identical module QDID + Host Stack can be added to the existing Product List for free via 'Manage Submitted Products' in SIG Launchstudio. No additional SIG Qualification Fee applies.
decision_logic:
1. Confirm the derivative product uses the identical module QDID and Host Stack as the already-certified product.
2. If yes → use 'Manage Submitted Products' in SIG Launchstudio to add the new product model → no additional Qualification Fee.
3. If module or Host Stack differs → new Design registration and Qualification Fee required.
final_recommendation: When a customer has multiple product models sharing the same Bluetooth configuration, always advise them to use 'Manage Submitted Products' for derived models to avoid unnecessary Qualification Fees.
risk_if_done_wrong: Starting a full new Design registration for a derivative product when it could be added for free via 'Manage Submitted Products' wastes the customer's Qualification Fee (¥150K–¥250K) unnecessarily.
